Container.Name: GameSync
Container.Overview: Experimental self-hosted server for synchronizing game saves between Windows and Linux computers. Choose an empty appdata directory and install the GameSync desktop client separately. Create the first pairing code from the container console as explained in the setup guide. The API uses HTTP: restrict access to a trusted network and use HTTPS through a reverse proxy or Tailscale Serve. Keep independent backups of your saves.

Config.Name: Server port
Config.Description: HTTP API port. Restrict access and use HTTPS for clients.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent server data. Choose a dedicated empty directory for a new installation.

Config.Name: Revisions to keep
Config.Description: Initial retention count; an administrator can later change the saved server policy.

Config.Name: Retention days
Config.Description: Initial retention age; an administrator can later change the saved server policy.
